text_block_list.text:
One day in February, I was working as 
usual when――

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Knock, knock! Excuse me!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: And once again, excuse me!
…… I wonder what that was.
(knocknocknocknocknock!)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san!? Why aren't you following 
me!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Come on, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Bakushinbakushiiiin!!

Not knowing what to expect, I followed her 
to the park, and found……

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Now, please, take this!

She handed me a pretty package. What on 
earth is this…?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Happy Valentine's Day, Trainer-san!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Why are you surprised!?
choice_data_list: Do you even know what Valentine's Day is?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Naturally! It's the day to give chocolate 
to those who have been good to us!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Every year, my classmates bring in a 
variety of sweets and we have a blast!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Similarly, I've received a lot of sweets, 
too! I'm quite popular, aren't I!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Maybe!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Ahem! Well, that's all well and good!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
However, I'm the class president! It's a 
no-go to take the initiative to hand out 
candy on campus!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
So I, using my brilliant mind, have 
decided that as long as it's off campus, 
it's OK!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
So, I tried my hand at making some 
chocolates!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Homemade is exemplary for these 
kinds of things, right?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I demonstrated such superior cooking 
ability to my home economics teacher that 
she said,"I'll give you credit for the 
class, just don't do anything else!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Well, in the end I managed to remove the 
debris and beat out the chunks of 
chocolate, so you can eat it!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I'm not exactly used to Valentine's Day, 
but…… I reaaaaally wanted to give this to 
you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Because Trainer-san is the one who helped 
me achieve my dream.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I still understand this much. I know how 
big my dream is.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
But I also know that with my superior 
speed, there's no way I can't make it come 
true.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
But truthfully, you were the only person 
outside of my family who understood.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
What am I saying! Fufu, you already 
understand, don't you, Trainer-san!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Anyways, please enjoy this token of my 
gratitude!

I really appreciate her sentiment, but I 
can't help but feel a little embarrassed 
when I have to reiterate my trust in her…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Indubitably, I do!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Are you sure!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I see, a reverse Valentine's Day! Then, 
I'd love to go, Bakushin-style!!

Afterwards, I took her to a restaurant 
that served chocolate fondue, and was 
relieved to see her looking quite 
satisfied.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Come on, come on, right here, right now!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Take a bite and let me hear you 
say "Mmm, that's delicious"!

…As expected…. I'll have to eat it right 
here, right now….!
(Crunch….munch, crunch)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ohh! It's got the perfect crunch! How 
about the taste?

… Tires? Tires, dirt, a hint of grass? At 
any rate, it has a very unique taste that 
can't be called chocolate…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Is that so!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, I knew it would be delicious 
since I was the one making it, but 
truthfully, I was a little worried.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I'm not as good at cooking as I am at 
running, but it still turned out 
delicious. Is that so…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, I'm so glad!

I was able to see that smile. That alone 
made for a great Valentine's Day…… I… 
think.
